page_title: BOL 1-0 ATA | Bologna v Atalanta 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90+3' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+1' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Atalanta win a corner.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joshua Zirkzee leaves the pitch and Michel Aebischer (Bologna) comes on.
88' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) is yellow-carded.
88' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

86' 1 - 0 Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
86' Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
85' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Teun Koopmeiners.
84' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
84' Chance! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
83' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Stefan Posch (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Yellow card. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
78' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ederson (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
77' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
75' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
74' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
74' Foul! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) for Ademola Lookman.
72' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replacing Sead Kolasinac.
71' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
70' What was Remo Freuler (Bologna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
67' The substitution has been made. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has replaced Matteo Ruggeri.
67' Here is a change. Charles De Ketelaere is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
66' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
66' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
64' A crossfield pass from Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates.
64' What a big chance! Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
58' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

57' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.

55' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Lukasz Skorupski was alert and the score remains the same.
54' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
52' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
51' The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Atalanta get a corner.
48' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
48' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
48' Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta). The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Thiago Motta gives a chance to Giovanni Fabbian and Nikola Moro (Bologna) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Antonio Rapuano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is substituted due to injury. Thiago Motta gives a chance to Kacper Urbanski.
44' A pass into the box finds Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Lukasz Skorupski denies him.
43' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
42' The game is interrupted now, Dan Ndoye (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' Remo Freuler (Bologna) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from a long-range free kick. He produces a stunning blast, which only just whistles wide of the left post.
40' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
38' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

37' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
37' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
35' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
34' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
32' The referee blows his whistle as Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) was too aggressive in his challenge.
31' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It's a throw-in for Bologna.
30' Stefan Posch (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
27' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bologna.
26' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
25' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Remo Freuler (Bologna) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
22' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
20' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
15' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
13' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
12' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
10' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
7' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Sam Beukema (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
4' The ball is cleared after Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' Stefan Posch (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Atalanta will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Antonio Rapuano.
